name: Enoch
overview: Enoch was a male descendant of Seth, uniquely identified as the son of Jared (GEN 5:18). Scripture highlights him as a man who walked closely with God, distinguished by his exceptional departure from earthly life. No additional tribal or surname details are provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Enoch means 'initiated' or 'follower,' reflecting a proper name given apart from divine naming (GEN 5:19). This meaning aligns with his portrayal as one who faithfully followed God.
familyAndRelationships: Enoch is explicitly recorded as the son of Jared and the father of Methuselah (GEN 5:18, 21). These relationships place him within the genealogical line of Seth, emphasizing his role in the biblical ancestry.
scriptureSignificance: Enoch stands out in Scripture for his intimate fellowship with God, evidenced by his walking with God for 300 years after Methuselah's birth. His life culminated in a unique divine act where God took him directly to heaven without experiencing death at the age of 365. Additionally, Enoch prophesied concerning the Lord's coming with His holy ones to execute judgment, underscoring his role as a prophet and a figure pointing forward to God's ultimate redemption and judgment.

keyEvents.event: Taken by God (did not see death)
